Major frac plug manufacturers include industry leaders `Halliburton, Weatherford, Baker Hughes, and specialized providers like Repeat Precision, WellBoss (Boss Hog), and Frontier Oil Tools` . These companies produce composite and dissolvable plugs for zonal isolation in hydraulic fracturing, designed for high pressure and quick drill-out performance.[[1]](https://www.repeatprecision.com/products/frac-plugs)[[2]](https://thewellboss.com/product_category/frac-plugs/#:~:text=Our%20frac%20plugs%20are%20well-known%20throughout%20the,to%20$4%2C000%20per%20well%20on%20water%20alone.)[[3]](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs/drillable-frac-plugs#:~:text=Halliburton%20also%20offers%20other%20drillable%20frac%20plugs%2C,total%20composite%20design%2C%20metal-free%2C%20and%20mandrel-less%20design)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JqtbyZlQ_zY&t=91)[[5]](https://www.fortunebusinessinsights.com/dissolvable-frac-plugs-market-110885)

**Key Frac Plug Manufacturers and Brands** 

- **[Halliburton](https://www.google.com/search?q=Halliburton&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjw1v-VlpGUAxU6JUQIHRZQOSIQgK4QegYIAQgAEAw):** Offers [Fas Drill® ultra](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs/drillable-frac-plugs) composite plugs and [Illusion® dissolvable](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs/dissolvable-frac-plug) plugs.
- **[Weatherford](https://www.google.com/search?q=Weatherford&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjw1v-VlpGUAxU6JUQIHRZQOSIQgK4QegYIAQgAEBA):** Manufactures the [TruFrac™](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JqtbyZlQ_zY) composite plug, specializing in in-house manufacturing for quality control.
- **[Repeat Precision](https://www.google.com/search?q=Repeat+Precision&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjw1v-VlpGUAxU6JUQIHRZQOSIQgK4QegYIAQgDEAE):** Produces the [PurpleSeal™](https://www.repeatprecision.com/products/frac-plugs) composite plug line.
- **[WellBoss](https://www.google.com/search?q=WellBoss&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjw1v-VlpGUAxU6JUQIHRZQOSIQgK4QegYIAQgDEAQ):** Known for the [Boss Hog](https://thewellboss.com/product_category/frac-plugs/) frac plug line designed for reliability and cost-efficient water usage.
- **[Frontier Oil Tools](https://www.google.com/search?q=Frontier+Oil+Tools&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjw1v-VlpGUAxU6JUQIHRZQOSIQgK4QegYIAQgDEAc):** Features the [RecedóТМ](https://frontieroiltools.com/completiontechnologies/plugs/) series of plugs.
- **[Innovex Downhole Solutions](https://www.google.com/search?q=Innovex+Downhole+Solutions&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjw1v-VlpGUAxU6JUQIHRZQOSIQgK4QegYIAQgDEAo):** Specializes in new-generation [dissolvable frac plugs](https://www.fortunebusinessinsights.com/dissolvable-frac-plugs-market-110885) for high-pressure/high-temperature wells.
- **[Yellow Jacket Oil Tools](https://www.google.com/search?q=Yellow+Jacket+Oil+Tools&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjw1v-VlpGUAxU6JUQIHRZQOSIQgK4QegYIAQgDEA0):** Provides specialized [frac plugs](https://ghdiv.com/frac-plugs-overview/) and downhole completion tools.
- **[Wildcat Oil Tools](https://www.google.com/search?q=Wildcat+Oil+Tools&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjw1v-VlpGUAxU6JUQIHRZQOSIQgK4QegYIAQgDEBA):** Offers [composite plugs](https://www.wildcatoiltools.com/wildcat-composite-plug) with ceramic button slip inserts.
- **[Rock West Composites](https://www.google.com/search?q=Rock+West+Composites&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjw1v-VlpGUAxU6JUQIHRZQOSIQgK4QegYIAQgDEBM):** Develops [ultra-high-performance frac plug materials](https://www.rockwestcomposites.com/rwc-delivers-first-ultra-high-performance-frac-plugs-for-new-contract.html) using filament wound fiberglass.
- **[Seven Canyons Composites](https://www.google.com/search?q=Seven+Canyons+Composites&csui=3&hl=en&gl=US&uule=w+CAIQIFISCQs2MuSEtepUEUK33kOSuTsc&ved=2ahUKEwjw1v-VlpGUAxU6JUQIHRZQOSIQgK4QegYIAQgDEBY):** Produces custom engineered composite plugs and frac balls.[[1]](https://www.repeatprecision.com/products/frac-plugs)[[2]](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs/drillable-frac-plugs#:~:text=Halliburton%20also%20offers%20other%20drillable%20frac%20plugs%2C,total%20composite%20design%2C%20metal-free%2C%20and%20mandrel-less%20design)[[3]](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JqtbyZlQ_zY&t=91)[[5]](https://www.repeatprecision.com/#:~:text=EXPERTLY%20ENGINEERED%20FOR%20POWERFUL%20PERFORMANCE%20At%20Repeat,oil%20well%20service%20companies%20in%20the%20industry.)[[6]](https://thewellboss.com/product_category/frac-plugs/#:~:text=Our%20frac%20plugs%20are%20well-known%20throughout%20the,to%20$4%2C000%20per%20well%20on%20water%20alone.)[[7]](https://frontieroiltools.com/completiontechnologies/plugs/)[[8]](https://www.fortunebusinessinsights.com/dissolvable-frac-plugs-market-110885)[[9]](https://ghdiv.com/frac-plugs-overview/#:~:text=Yellow%20Jacket%20Oil%20Tools'%20advanced%20frac%20plugs,performance%20in%20hydraulic%20fracturing%20and%20well%20completions.)[[10]](https://www.wildcatoiltools.com/wildcat-composite-plug#:~:text=Wildcat%20Oil%20Tools%20frac%20plugs%20offer%20a,button%20slip%20inserts%20to%20minimize%20wellbore%20debris.)[[11]](https://www.rockwestcomposites.com/rwc-delivers-first-ultra-high-performance-frac-plugs-for-new-contract.html)[[12]](https://www.sevencanyonscomposites.com/)

**Key Market Trends and Materials** 

- **Dissolvable Technology:** Baker Hughes and others are advancing dissolvable magnesium alloy plugs to eliminate the need for mill-out operations.
- **Composite Materials:** Manufacturers such as [Atlas Fibre](https://www.atlasfibre.com/composite-frac-plugs/) produce glass-reinforced epoxy components for easy drill-out.
- **Manufacturing Focus:** Many firms focus on reducing wellbore debris and increasing pressure ratings (often exceeding 10,000 psi).[[1]](https://www.halliburton.com/en/completions/well-completions/frac-plugs/drillable-frac-plugs#:~:text=Halliburton%20also%20offers%20other%20drillable%20frac%20plugs%2C,total%20composite%20design%2C%20metal-free%2C%20and%20mandrel-less%20design)[[2]](https://www.fortunebusinessinsights.com/dissolvable-frac-plugs-market-110885)[[3]](https://www.atlasfibre.com/composite-frac-plugs/#:~:text=Atlas%20Fibre%20has%20the%20materials%2C%20capability%20and,compared%20to%20cast%20iron%20or%20aluminum%20plugs.)[[4]](https://frontieroiltools.com/completiontechnologies/plugs/)[[5]](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12666-025-03643-6#:~:text=The%20inception%20of%20dissolvable%20Mg%20alloys%20marked,Hughes%20in%202010%20revolutionized%20downhole%20equipment%20activation.)
